tasks.title: Keep output gaps out of the terminal screen
tasks.objective: Represent bounded live-output loss as an out-of-band signal, keep the newest output flowing, and request one current-screen redraw when the Run is healthy.
tasks.outcome: Terminal live output never writes the historical-gap diagnostic into xterm; TerminalView owns the gap notice and redraw convergence.
acceptance: A true byte gap returns a structured gap signal while writing only retained output; overlap and contiguous batches do not signal a gap.
TerminalView has a production caller for the structured signal, shows the service notice, requests redraw, and clears only after a successful current-screen repaint.
Mutation that removes the structured gap branch makes the focused tests fail.

verification.ref: cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec vitest run test/terminal-live-output.test.ts test/terminal-redraw-feedback.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Gap signal, live output wiring, and redraw feedback
The gap capability is consumed outside its defining module

tasks.title: Render all Codex user turns
tasks.objective: Keep every persisted user_message visible in Codex conversation mode across live events and timeline snapshot resync.
tasks.outcome: The conversation view renders at least two independent user rows in order and does not collapse later turns into the first prompt.
acceptance: Two user_message timeline items render as two user rows with their original text and order.
A timeline gap path resyncs from the authoritative snapshot without dropping later user messages.
Mutation that removes the later-message projection makes the focused renderer/store test fail.

verification.ref: cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec vitest run test/activity-view.test.tsx test/activity-timeline-rows.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

verification.proves: The timeline user-message capability has production callers

tasks.title: Align restoring and redraw surfaces
tasks.objective: Keep restoring as a high-quality Region stage with distinct replay semantics and make top redraw feedback converge after zoom or a successful repaint.
tasks.outcome: Restoring and starting-agent surfaces share layout quality but remain distinguishable, and a confirmed current grid removes stale redraw feedback.
acceptance: Restoring copy and visual selectors describe replay/reattach, while starting-agent copy describes waiting for first output.
The redraw prompt is attached to the visible Region and is cleared by successful redraw or authoritative grid confirmation.
The focused surface contract test has a non-empty source scan and fails when the restoring distinction or top prompt rule is removed.

verification.ref: cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec vitest run test/terminal-hydration-brand.test.ts test/terminal-redraw-feedback.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1
